approaches.summary: Grow BLOCK_SIZE_M from the resolver default 128 to 256 on both gemm1 and down fp8 configs, stacked on the round-1 per-M GROUP_SIZE_M remap (M<=1024->1, M<4096->4, M>=4096->16). Feed the overridden BM to moe_align_block_size so grid and padding agree. BLOCK_SIZE_M resizes the program->tile mapping, grid, and moe_align padding but NEVER touches BLOCK_SIZE_K (fp32 K-accumulation) -> bit-exact (calc_diff 0.0 all shapes, all three clean gates). 512 overflows LDS and is infeasible. approaches.why: A 256-row token tile amortizes the shared fp8 weight loads over 2x the rows vs the resolver's 128-row default for this compute-bound fused-MoE. BLOCK_SIZE_M is a token-tile RESIZE (sibling to GROUP_SIZE_M): it changes the program->tile mapping and grid but never the fp32 K-accumulation order, so calc_diff stays 0.0. The win is uniform across all three M shapes (+18% M1024, +4% M2048, +11% M4096), flipping the round-1 M=4096 neutral (cons 0.978) to a win (cons 1.105). moe_align_block_size must be fed the overridden BM; otherwise grid and padding disagree.

lesson: moe_total_prefill fp8 round-2 win on gfx942: BLOCK_SIZE_M is a bit-exact token-tile RESIZE (sibling to GROUP_SIZE_M) -- growing 128->256 amortizes shared fp8 weight loads for compute-bound fused-MoE, never touches BLOCK_SIZE_K, stays calc_diff 0.0. Always feed the overridden BM to moe_align_block_size (else grid/padding disagree). 512 overflows LDS. Stacked on the round-1 GROUP_SIZE_M remap: geo 1.0464 (round-1) -> 1.117 (round-2), 3/3 win (M=4096 flips from neutral 0.978 to win 1.105), 0 regress. Opposite regime from moe_total_decode: decode is memory-bound at tiny M and the correct direction is SHRINK BM to fit live rows; prefill is compute-bound at larger M and the correct direction is GROW BM to amortize weight loads.
transfers_to: fp8 fused-MoE prefill on gfx942 at compute-bound M where the resolver's BLOCK_SIZE_M=128 default under-tiles the token dimension

caveats: BLOCK_SIZE_M=512 overflows LDS and is infeasible on gfx942; 256 is the maximum safe value.
moe_align_block_size must be called with the overridden BLOCK_SIZE_M (not the resolver's default); otherwise the grid and padding disagree and correctness breaks.
Bit-exactness depends on BLOCK_SIZE_K/N staying fixed and AITER_TRITON_ONLY=0 (pinned-CK module_quant.so); otherwise the fp8 reference silently degrades.
